5. Enable OSPF process 1 and advertise network 192.168.150.0 0.0.0.255 area 0.
expected_configuration:
vlan 150
 name Branch_5
!
interface FastEthernet0/5
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 150
 no shutdown
!
ip routing
!
interface Vlan150
 ip address 192.168.150.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 network 192.168.150.0 0.0.0.255 area 0

requirement: Create an access list to block HTTP traffic from subnet 192.168.10.0/24 and apply it in on GigabitEthernet0/1.

access-list 101 permit ip any any
!
